notes: The fixture is derived only; raw source archives remain in ignored var/phase7/raw.
Both sources are U.S. Government works treated as public domain; attribution and source URLs are retained.
Weather is an observation, not a forecast. The same-day relationship is an association unless a defensible identification design is supplied.

panel.geography: ERCOT balancing authority / Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas
panel.timezone_note: EIA Data Date is the local operating day; NOAA DATE is the station local observation day.

limitations: balanced/submitted data may reflect operator corrections after the operating day
the current bulk archive is not an as-issued historical vintage
hourly demand is not a settlement-grade revenue-meter record
sources.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration Form EIA-930
sources.transform: ERCO hourly Demand (MW) aggregated to daily mean, peak, minimum and summed MWh; DST days retain their actual 23/24/25 hourly observations.

limitations: a point station is not an area-weighted temperature for the whole ERCOT footprint
quality-controlled archive values are not a historical forecast
the current archive does not establish the exact data publicly available on each historical date
sources.name: NOAA NCEI Global Historical Climatology Network Daily
sources.transform: TMAX/TMIN tenths of degrees Celsius converted to Celsius; daily mean is the arithmetic mean of TMAX and TMIN; no infilling.
